## About
Jammers Auto Body was started by Joel Jonas, a master body man and painter who built a reputation for outstanding quality work at a fair price. Al Reeves, who got his start in his dad's shop in Dallas, came on as a partner and later became sole owner.
Our team includes Ron Ostrander, our manager and lead estimator, who worked at the Lexus dealer and was a body technician before that, and Kim Egyed, our office manager, who owned a Ferrari repair shop with her husband. Many of our experienced technicians have been with us for years.
Today we work out of our own building on Buttercup Street, with the space to take on everything from a simple collision repair to complicated European vehicles. Cars come to us from all over the greater Houston area and around the state.

## Services
- Collision repair: From small fender benders to bigger accident damage, on all makes and models.
- Paint refinishing: Paint refinishing is one of our specialties, on everything from Fords to Porsches.
- Paintless dent repair: Dents taken out without repainting the panel.
- Glass replacement: Replacement of damaged auto glass.
- Alignments, upholstery repairs and window tint: Other work we handle alongside body repair.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies.

Q: Is your paintwork warrantied?
A: Yes. Our paintwork comes with a manufacturer backed lifetime warranty.
